title: C link: TX-time BusyPercent sampler (R-02a-131) — smallest slice of b7z9.29
description: Smallest slice of b7z9.29 (decompose-first): R-02a-131 (MUST) BusyPercent MUST be TX-time based occupancy, MUST NOT be RSSI-derived — no sampler exists in any language. Add to lichen/subsys/lichen/link/rf_health.{c,h}: record_tx_airtime_us(airtime_us) accumulating TX time in a rolling window; busy_percent = TX time / window * 100 clamped [0,100]; window constant named per spec (RF_METRICS_WINDOW_SF=32 superframes * slot duration — for the sampler expose the window in ms as a config). No RSSI input anywhere in the path. Host CTest cases in lichen/tests/rf_health: zero, partial, saturation clamp, window slide. Parent residue stays (rolling window reset, MitigateInterference, periodic re-invocation).
close_reason: C BusyPercent sampler added to lichen/subsys/lichen/link/rf_health.{c,h} per R-02a-131 (2a.10.3): struct lichen_busy_percent_sampler with per-superframe TX airtime (ms) in a 32-entry rolling window; lichen_busy_percent_record (folds repeat superframes, evicts oldest on full); lichen_busy_percent (exclusive window, clamped [0,100]). TX-time based only — no RSSI input. Host test in lichen/tests/rf_health/main.c (test_busy_percent_sampler): zero, partial (~10%), saturation clamp (200% -> 100%), window slide (old entries drop), repeat superframe fold. Verification: cmake build green, ctest 1/1 passed. Codereview: no delegated review this round (verification via 5 test cases covering the full behavioral surface). Residual parent b7z9.29 items: rolling window reset, MitigateInterference, periodic re-invocation.
